Subject: Clarification regarding consideration of eligible service for grant of MACP in the
Rajbhasha Cadre - reg.

MadamiSir,

Some references have been received from Zonal Offices regarding the issue of
eligible service for grant of MACP to the officers in the Rajbhasha Cadre i.e. JTO / STO/ AD(OL)
etc. In this regard, it is informed that as per HRD circular dated 16.07.2003 (copy enclosed), the
Service for the purpose of eligibility for grant of ACP/MACP shall be counted from the date of
appointment to the post of JTO (erstwhile Hindi Translator Gr.Il) against DR/DP Quota.

2. Necessary action may be taken by Zonal Office on the said matter accordingly.
Further, it is requested that the pending MACP cases of the officers in the Rajbhasha cadre may
be completed within 10 days. MACP that has already been granted/denied taking into
Consideration service prior to appointment in the cadre of JTO may be reviewed and necessary
